sections.title: Sound of the letter ci
paragraphs: The letter name is (ci) /tʃi/. Its main sound is heard in the word (casa) /ˈka.za/, which means house, home. This letter makes two different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the back of your tongue against the soft roof. Stop the air completely, then release it sharply without voice. For the second sound, touch your tongue tip just behind your top teeth. Release the air slowly into a hiss. Put your fingers on your throat to feel that your voice stays silent for both.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Before a, o, u, or consonants, this letter sounds like the first consonant in (corpo) /ˈkɔr.po/. Before e or i, it makes a different sound, as in (cena) /ˈtʃe.na/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not blow a puff of air out when you say the sound in (casa) /ˈka.za/. Keep it crisp and dry, unlike the first consonant in English cat. For the sound in (ciao) /ˈtʃa.o/, avoid sliding into a soft hiss like the middle sound in vision. Start with a firm stop, exactly like the first sound in chair.
